The '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and solid yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], with flat lips, naturally downturned [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]], [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] heads, and a lack of visible [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]]. At least two members of this species, clad in identical yellow and purple robes and headgear, were present in [[Bezz Drexx's tower]] some time during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Spy Girls" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species appeared in the short comic story "[[Spy Girls]]" illustrated by [[Stewart McKenny]] and collected within ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 7]]'',<ref name="Spy Girls" /> released on [[January 31]], [[2007]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/14-333/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Volume-7|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 7}}</ref>
